meta.name: brand-landingpage
meta.description: Brand-first landing page designer — runs a brand-identity interview (colors, typography, shape language), then generates and iterates on a polished landing page via Stitch with deployment-ready HTML. Use when the user asks to create, design, or build a landing page, homepage, or marketing page and has no established visual direction. Skip when they have a design mockup, need a dashboard or app UI, are working at component level, building a multi-page app, or restyling with known design tokens — use frontend-design instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 进行品牌访谈,生成可直接部署的落地页
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要一个有品牌调性的落地页但还没定视觉方向
copy.tagline_en: Run a brand interview and generate a deployable landing page.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a brand-oriented landing page but don't have a visual direction.

howto.what: 它会先问你品牌相关的问题（配色、字体、形状），再用 Stitch 生成落地页，按你的反馈反复修改，最后交付含 index.html、DESIGN.md 的可部署打包文件。
howto.when: 当你要求创建、设计或搭建落地页、主页、营销页，且没有既定视觉方向时触发。已有设计稿、要做仪表盘或多页应用时不用它。

say.text: 帮我给这个产品做一个落地页
say.note: 先进入约 10 题的品牌访谈

say.text: 给我看几个不同的设计方案
say.note: 一次生成 3 个变体供你对比

say.text: 再帮我生成一个手机版布局
say.note: 用 MOBILE 模式生成，通常评审 1~2 轮

howto.what_en: It first interviews you about brand direction (colors, fonts, shapes), then generates a landing page with Stitch, iterates on your feedback, and delivers a deployable bundle with index.html, DESIGN.md and DEPLOY.md.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create, design or build a landing page, homepage or marketing page with no established visual direction. Skip if you have a mockup or need a dashboard or app UI.

say_en.text: Build a landing page for my product
Show me a few different design options
